scenes.text: Have you ever noticed that almost every spiral staircase inside ancient medieval castles curves to the right as you climb up?
If you were an invading soldier charging up these narrow steps with a sword in your right hand, the inner stone wall would constantly block your swing, leaving you completely defenseless.
However, the defenders waiting at the top had all the space they needed to swing their weapons downward and easily slice you to pieces.
With intentionally uneven steps designed to make you trip in the dark, do you think you could have survived a medieval siege?
